newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper, zinc gains, others lose.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper, zinc gains, others lose.

text.p: Indian copper and zinc prices on Tuesday extended gains while tin and nickel lost fresh ground on the back of fresh selling on world market losses, dealers said.
Copper rose by 50 rupees at 13,950 rupees per quintal and zinc rose by 50 rupees at 8,100 rupees as an uptrend in the world market prompted speculative buying.

Dealers said tin and nickel fell on higher supplies while overseas losses prompted fresh selling. Tin was down by 300 rupees at 30,600 rupees per quintal after losing 500 rupees last week while nickel was down by 200 rupees at 36,000 rupees per quintal after losing 300 rupees during last week.
Aluminium was quiet at 7,700 rupees and lead unchanged at 4,100 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
